results.rationale: Consistency: fruit arrangement, tabletop and framing are maintained; seed details change slightly. Instruction: cut flesh becomes yellow-brown and whole apples acquire decay, visibly showing elapsed time. Knowledge: oxidation discoloration is present as expected, though extensive peel decay accompanies relatively pale cut flesh. Quality: recognizable fruit and convincing lighting, but several dark rot patches resemble fabric overlays and peel edges look artificially detached.

Consistency: wooden table and paper arrangement remain, but paper creases are broadly reconstructed. Instruction: all three loaves are removed, leaving no bread instead of two loaves. Quality: coherent crumpled-paper surface, with a mildly unnatural smoothed central patch.
